description: This file implements an abstract attachment system for a game, providing functions to attach and retrieve positional and directional data for various attachment types such as static points, tags, centities, and particles.

methods.name: CG_AttachmentPoint
methods.description: Returns the position of an attachment point based on its type (static, tag, cent, particle).

methods.name: CG_AttachmentDir
methods.description: Returns the direction vector of an attachment.

methods.name: CG_AttachmentAxis
methods.description: Returns the axis matrix of an attachment.

methods.name: CG_AttachmentVelocity
methods.description: Returns the velocity of an attachment if applicable.

methods.name: CG_AttachmentCentNum
methods.description: Returns the entity number associated with a centity attachment.

methods.name: CG_Attached
methods.description: Checks if an attachment is currently attached.

methods.name: CG_AttachToPoint
methods.description: Attaches to a static point in space.

methods.name: CG_SetAttachmentPoint
methods.description: Sets the position of an attachment point.

methods.name: CG_SetAttachmentCent
methods.description: Sets the centity for an attachment.

methods.name: CG_SetAttachmentTag
methods.description: Sets the model tag for an attachment.

methods.name: CG_SetAttachmentParticle
methods.description: Sets the particle for an attachment.

methods.name: CG_SetAttachmentOffset
methods.description: Sets the offset for an attachment.
